title: Clear Ore Outlines
description: A clean and performance-friendly resource pack that adds distinct, highly visible borders to all vanilla Minecraft ores.
body:
# Clear Ore Outlines
Tired of missing valuable resources while exploring dark caves or rushing through deepslate layers? **Clear Ore Outlines** is a clean, performance-friendly resource pack designed to give all vanilla Minecraft ores a distinct, highly visible border. 


### ✨ Features
* **High-Visibility Borders:** Every standard ore block features a sharp, color-coded outline matching its material.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Retains the original texture style of Minecraft while enhancing readability.

### 🛠️ Compatibility
* Works perfectly on modern versions, including **1.20.x and 1.21.x**.
* It can be used in conjunction with other PvP or utility resource packs (just make sure to put this resource pack at the top of your pack list!).
